# Cloud Native Platform (CNP)

> CNP is the 3-Istor internal developer platform: teams create projects and deploy apps from templates (static or FastAPI + React + PostgreSQL) onto Kubernetes through GitOps, with SSO, Vault secrets, monitoring, FinOps and canary releases. The CMP (https://cmp.3istor.com) is its portal. AI assistants use it through the MCP server https://cmp.3istor.com/mcp.

## Use CNP from an AI assistant

- [Connect an assistant](https://cmp.3istor.com/connect-ai): setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, VS Code
- [CMP MCP integration](https://3-istor.github.io/cnp-docs/05-cmp-backend-api/11-cmp-mcp-integration/): OAuth flow, stake policy, tools
- [CNP agent kit](https://github.com/3-Istor/cnp-agent-kit): platform guides (skills), Claude Code plugin, doctrine rules
